name: Heroes of Throgg
storyline:
Heroes of Throgg is a fantasy RPG set in a world filled with ancient magic, dangerous creatures, and forgotten civilizations.

As darkness spreads across the land, adventurers from all walks of life rise to face an ever-growing threat. From monster-infested forests and haunted crypts to ancient ruins and otherworldly realms, heroes must battle fearsome enemies, defeat powerful bosses, and uncover the secrets of a world on the brink of chaos.
